title: Well and Cellar
author: Sable Marchetti
blurb: Quentin Crane, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
